Results.ReviewText: Great grill, only used two times. Wife wanted smoke
Results.Title: Great

Results.ReviewText: It is made to very high standards. Also the quality is what Weber is known for.
Results.Title: Time honored traditions

Results.ReviewText: Got this as a birthday present after having my eye on one for a while.  Have one cook on it and it did a wonderful job.  I usually don't review products but felt compelled to do so after my experience with Weber customer service.  The lid had a piece of enamel chip directly under the handle where it bolts together.  It wouldn't affect the performance in my opinion but bothered me on a brand new beautiful looking grill.  I sent a picture in to the warranty request line and they have sent me a brand new lid!  Unreal service!  I won't hesitate to buy Weber in the future (I've had my eye on a Smokey Mountain, can't wait!).
Results.Title: Love this kettle

Results.ReviewText: I've only cooked on it a few times but seems to work well
Results.Title: New

Results.ReviewText: I mean, you look at this beautiful thing and you just know it's going to work and deliver time and time again. It's not the most crazy of designs, but the parts are quality parts and I know it'll last. The simple add-on features (ash catcher / grill grate lift areas, etc.) make this a simple win.
Results.Title: quality quality quality

Results.ReviewText: Replaced my 10 year old Weber and performers perfectly like my last.
Results.Title: Exactly what I wanted

Results.ReviewText: Great all around grill fun to use will purchase another after Christmas
Results.Title: The Original

Results.ReviewText:
I have had my Weber for two summers now, and I love it! I use it every chance I get when the weather is nice.
Load it up with coal to do big cooks, or just use one basket, and smoke with it. 
The only complaint I can think of is the thermometer isn't at all accurate, but I didn't expect it to be. I use a digital probe for accuracy. Can't recommend these kettles enough.
Results.Title: Extremely Versatile

Results.ReviewText: Cooked my Thanksgiving turkey on the grill. In 77 years one of the best turkeys I had have eaten. I've never tried anything on a grill of this size.
Results.Title: Thanksgiving Turkey

Results.ReviewText: These are the best grills ever invented. I love mine cook on it all the time
Results.Title: THE GREATEST GRILL EVER

Results.ReviewText: I really like this unit and I would’ve given it four stars except that the spring handle on the dash opener is too difficult to open easily. Also I miss the wooden handles that I had on my old Weber these new handles are plastic and probably won’t last as long. I had my last weber grill for 30 years Before the metal legs finally gave way.
Results.Title: A very good grill and easy to move!

Results.ReviewText: I only buy weber grills. This is the best charcoal grill I have ever owned.
Results.Title: Charcoal Grill of choice

Results.ReviewText: Great charcoal grill. Easy to get the temp you want and the options are endless for cooking options! I love it!
Results.Title: Best Kettle out there

Results.ReviewText: I love it, the temp. gauge is so nice and the ash catcher there is so much less of a mess

always wanted one, checks all the boxes for a charcoal grill. heavy metal cooking tub.
needed to get another charcoal starter chimney.

Results.ReviewText: Great quality grill as usual and like all the others we have had.
Results.Title: Great GRILL

Results.ReviewText: Excellent cooking grill.  This is the 4th one in my 49 years of using them.
Results.Title: Performance.

Results.ReviewText: I have used a Weber Grill since 1978. That speaks for Its self. This is my 4th Weber. One was stolen from my back yard.
Results.Title: Only way to grill.
Switching from gas to charcoal and loving it!!!!!!

Results.ReviewText: This 22 inch weber premium is just what I needed to replace my 18 inch kettle
Results.Title: I love it!

Results.ReviewText: My 3rd one as moving wouldnt alllow me to keep the others. Just cant live without one!
Results.Title: Original Premium Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Everything good; but the hook on the hood is too short — makes it tricky to hang on the grill — and I wish the hood vent had a plastic grip the way the 26” does.
Results.Title: Enjoying my new Weber

Results.ReviewText: This charcoal grill is a solid performer.  I have used this same style Weber for many years.  My only complaint is with the lid hanging hook design on this particular model located under the lid and designed to hang off the rim of the bowl. It doesn't always catch unless I bend over and actually guide it onto the rim.  I had a Deluxe model many years ago that had a wire rod groove that was bolted on so the lid nestled just at the outside of the bowl.  when I reached out to customer service I was told this accessory was not available for add on. Such a shame it is not as the addition of this option would take this Grill rating to a 5+
Results.Title: Solid Performer

Results.ReviewText: I real enjoy cooking on the Weber Kettle.  It's an easy to use, mult-purpose grill.  I use it almost everyday.  It's great for cooking steaks, chicken, burgers, etc.  I also use it as a smoker to cook pork butts.  I highly recommend this grill.
Results.Title: Great easy to use, multi-purpose grill!

Results.ReviewText: Excellent service, excellent product. Would buy one of these over a green egg any day. I have perfected steaks, salmon and chicken on my Weber grill! Long lasting and durable as well!
Results.Title: Weber 22” Kettle Grill

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
